actualPromptText:
Use case: stylized-concept. Actual production 2D game sprites for Tantalus Tunnel Vermin, move. The LAST image is the single project identity reference (a pale plated cave arthropod). Draw NEW poses of exactly that arthropod, never copy its checkerboard.
Identity lock: Original Tantalus Reach cave fauna with no external model: one small extremely low ground arthropod in strict right-facing orthographic profile, with one protected burrowing head, reduced simple eye/sensors, one mandibular mouth, short tactile appendages, a stable segmented abdomen and exactly eight individually readable locomotor limbs. Preserve the V56 identity, 180x76 logical runtime envelope, fixed segment count, attachment points, body length and supporting-foot baseline across all 32 future poses. Materials are pale gray-ivory matte organic chitin, translucent cool-gray joints, dusty mineral abrasion and only sparse cold photophore pinpoints. Despite swarm caste, every cell contains exactly one animal. Never resemble a Facehugger, Chestburster, mini-xenomorph, metallic shell, giant boss or multi-subject swarm. All future pixels must be original project art, canonExact=false.
Motion: Exactly one8-phase metachronal eight-legged SCUTTLE cycle. Four near-side legs and four offset far-side legs retain the same attachment points. A coordinated rear-to-front stepping wave travels through the eight legs across all8frames, including contact/lift/passing/replant; not the same four poses repeated. Do not translate body within the cell or rotate camera.
Layout: EXACTLY8 chronological poses in4columns by2rows on1774x887 landscape canvas. Strict orthographic side view facingRIGHT, identical scale, one complete animal in everycell, consistent registration and feetgroundline. Maintain fixed count, shape and overlap order of broad dorsal shell plates shown in reference. Body and antennae completely contained inside eachcell with24px clear margins. Preserve near/far-side limb identities and smallspecies proportions. No additional animals, no frame overlap.
Detailed crisp handpainted2Dgame bitmap, not3D/isometric. Pale naturalgray-ivory chitin and charcoaljoint shadows, sparsecyanphotophores as reference, not purewhiteflat silhouette.
BACKGROUND: flat pureMAGENTA #FF00FF, uniform in every gap. DO NOT COPY ANY WHITE/GRAY CHECKERBOARD. No transparency-preview squares, white field, floor, shadow, text, numbers, grid, particles or UI. The image will be chroma-extracted separately. No proceduralrecolor, no interpolation, no duplicateframes.
note: Completed built-in image_gen call; original returned PNG persisted byte-for-byte on D:. Tool returned image bytes only. Local receipt label is not a provider generation ID. In-memory reference previews were used after native path loading failed with Windows ACL-helper error.
